Cut 8 of the `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`). The claim is `6419652034`. Six bodies of the "Compatibility API" section move unedited into a new module, `packages/objectql/src/engine-compatibility-api.ts`: `registerObject`, `getConfigs`, `introspectDatasource`, `syncSchemas`, `syncObjectSchema` and `removePackage`. No behaviour changes. #25522 stays open for the later cuts.

Branch `claude/project-thread-4vp88a` (the card thread's harness-pinned branch), cut from `origin/main` at `7111e14ac`, which contains cut 7's merge (`dbfb52a66`, #26160).

Sections are cut 1's contiguous member ranges, re-located by first member name, docblocks included. The measuring script, run on cut 7's base `d1ea2363f`, reproduces cut 7's table and move screen byte for byte, so the readings compare. The per-method move screen for every section, and the full pricing, are in the project file `pm-orders/server/25522-cut8-seam-table.md`. A body stays if any of these holds: an inferred-return public method, a U site, a private-static read, an `objectql/src/engine.ts#NAME` pointer under `packages/spec/**` or `docs/adr/**`, a `this.update(` / `this.insert(` / `this.delete(` self-call, or a static. Bodies earlier cuts moved count as stubs, not as movable.

Pricing (net `engine.ts` lines): a stub costs a comment, the host literal's open and close and the `.call`, plus two lines per field read (a `read*` closure and a getter) and one per method read (a late-bound closure); a body that reads no member costs two; the import adds about three.

What stays in the section: `getDriverByName` (ADR-0096 cites it as `engine.ts#getDriverByName`); `create` (a static factory); `createContext`, which passes the engine itself to `ScopedContext`, a class `engine.ts` defines, so its body would need a value import of the engine (a run-time cycle); and `unregisterObject`, `getObject`, `getDriverForObject`, `dropObjectSchema`, `datasource`, `on` and `close`, whose stubs would cost as much as their bodies or more.

## The shape (#23050 shape B, as cuts 1 to 7 apply it)

- The class keeps all six methods with name, modifiers, signature, docblock and position. Each body is now one host literal plus `fn.call(host, …)`, marked `[#25522 cut 8]`. All six are public with declared return types, so none is an inferred-return public member.
- `CompatibilityApiHost` is new: `_registry`, `drivers`, `hooks`, `logger`, `getDriverForObject`, `removeActionsByPackage`, each typed as the class member (`ObjectQL['_registry']`). Each moved function types its `this` as the `Pick` of exactly the members its body reads, and each stub annotates its literal as `ThisParameterType` of that function. There is no cast, and no member changes visibility.
- The four fields go as GETTERS, so each read happens when the body makes it. The two methods go as late-bound closures over the instance, so a double or spy set on the engine still intercepts (`syncSchemas` and `syncObjectSchema` call the public `getDriverForObject`, which a caller may override).
- `registerObject` keeps its default parameter (`packageId: string = '__runtime__'`) on both the method and the function; the stub passes the value it received.
- **Imports.** The module imports `ObjectQL` as a TYPE only and nothing re-exports it. Its value imports are `StorageNameMapping` (`@objectstack/spec/system`) and `isFederatedObject` (`./federated-object.js`), the same bindings `engine.ts` uses; both still have readers in `engine.ts`, so its import list is unchanged apart from the new module import.

## Net lines (the seat's rule)

`engine.ts` goes from 23,165 to 23,095 lines, **net -70** (46 added, 116 removed). The module is 225 lines: the header and host interface (about 66), six one-line docblocks, and the 116 moved body lines with their signatures. With the two re-keyed rows of the reader pin, the diff is 391 changed lines over 3 files (+273 / -118), far under the 3,000-line human-merge threshold.

## Proof of move-only

A TypeScript-AST leaf-token compare (recursive `getChildren`, JSDoc skipped) of base `engine.ts` (`7111e14ac`) against the head module:

- For each of the six, the parameters (less `this`, default value included), return type, type parameters and body tokens are **SAME**, `async` matches, and every body line equals the base line less two leading spaces, comments included: `registerObject` 72 tokens / 9 lines, `getConfigs` 57 / 8, `introspectDatasource` 58 / 8, `syncSchemas` 312 / 63, `syncObjectSchema` 117 / 17, `removePackage` 79 / 11.
- **Negative controls:** flipping `=== 'function'` to `!== 'function'` on the `syncSchema` probe in the moved `syncSchemas` reports DIFFER on its body tokens; editing only one comment in the moved `syncObjectSchema` fails the line rule. Both exit 1, and the module was restored from `HEAD` and its blob hash compared after each.
- Class: 318 members at both ends, in the same order. 312 are byte-identical (full text, docblocks included), and the 6 stubs keep docblock, modifiers and signature byte-identical up to the body.
- Top level: 230 of 231 base statements are byte-identical in head; the other is the class. Head adds the new module import with its comment.

## Readers of the moved lines

- **Reader pin (migrated in this PR).** `packages/objectql/src/federated-injected-column-readers.test.ts` keys every federated-predicate use in `@objectstack/objectql`'s source as `FILE#FUNCTION :: SEAM`. The two schema-sync rows move from `engine.ts#syncSchemas` / `engine.ts#syncObjectSchema` to `engine-compatibility-api.ts#syncSchemas` / `#syncObjectSchema`, with the same disposition and reason. Control: with the base copy of the test restored over this head, it goes red naming exactly those two new keys (1 failed / 4 passed), so the pin does read the moved code; restored from `HEAD`, blob hash compared.
- **ADR anchors.** No `scripts/adr-anchors/` entry describes a moved body: the engine entry's one paragraph is the transaction seam, and its ids stay cited in `engine.ts`. So no entry is added. `check-adr-anchors` at base `7111e14ac`: 89 anchored files, 1,881 decision-letter citations; at head: 89 anchored files, 1,881 decision-letter citations (resolving citations 59,157 → 59,159, the module header's two ADR ids). The moved bodies cite no decision letter.
- No `objectql/src/engine.ts#NAME` pointer under `packages/spec/**` or `docs/adr/**` names the six. Prose that names a method with `ObjectQL.` or `engine.` (ADR-0015 on `ObjectQL.syncObjectSchema`, `federated-object.ts`, `plugin.ts`, `error-code-ledger.zod.ts` comments, the durability checker's `syncObjectSchema` vocabulary) still resolves, because every method stays on the class.
- No gate baseline keys a moved body: `durability-read-invention.baseline.json` names `referenceExists` only, and `query-options-erasure` reports its key set unchanged with the file counts held. The tests that assert the moved bodies' runtime messages (`external-write-gate.test.ts`, `schema-sync-durability-log-level.test.ts`, `sync-schemas-federated-object.test.ts`) assert behaviour, not source text, and pass.

## Acceptance notes

- `createContext` (8 body lines) was priced at about -6 by cut 7; it hands `this` (the engine) to `ScopedContext`, which `engine.ts` defines, so the body cannot move without a value import of the engine. Left in the class.
- `removePackage` mutates the hook map through the getter (`this.hooks.set(…)`), the same object, so the write lands where it did; it is not a field assignment, and no setter is needed.
- Serial check, re-read before `pr_create`: 36 PRs are open; none touches `packages/objectql/src/**`. #26203 edits `packages/objectql/tsconfig*.json`, #26198 and #25640 edit `packages/objectql/package.json` (and the changelog), outside this PR's files. `origin/main` moved 15 commits after the base, none on `packages/objectql/**`; the only `scripts/adr-anchors/**` change is the driver-sql pair from #26169. `dispatch-gates` printed no stale-tree warning, so `main` was not merged in.
- Next cut from this screen: Execution plumbing (about -55: `buildSession`, `buildProvenance`, `buildEvalUser`, `buildUser`, none reading a member), then Autonumber (about -75, warmer). Migration flags still needs a setter ruling.

- Dependants: every changed member keeps its declaration and all six published `.d.ts` files are byte-identical, so no dependant can see a difference. CI's `TypeScript Type Check` covers them.
- Gates at `9fce8d910`: `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 62 families on the real diff. Every one was run, each exit code captured before any pipe, then reconciled with `--ran`: 62 accounted for, 61 run, 1 NOT MEASURED. **NOT MEASURED** (CI runs it): `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (it needs every package's `dist/`; the export lists above answer it for objectql). `check:lean-entry-closure` first exited 3 for want of objectql's `dist/` and was re-run green after the head build (15 packages, the admitted set held). Named readings: `check-system-context-census` OK (151 read sites, 144 of 144 symbols cited), `check:logger-receiver-detach` OK (3,737 files, 0 detaches), `check:durability-log-level` exit 0, `check:query-options-erasure` exit 0 (key set verified, no files added), `check-engine-split-ratio --days 90` 97.6%.
- Hand gates outside the derivation, all exit 0 at `9fce8d910`: `check-adr-anchors` at base and head (above), `check-adr-symbol-anchors` (2,660 anchors resolve), `check-tenant-audit-census` (243 write call sites), `check-nul-bytes`, `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` (13 anchors judged, 0 lost) and `check-commit-card-trailers --range origin/main..HEAD`.
- No ablation, because no tested behaviour changed. `test:repo` was not run locally; CI's `Test Core` runs it.

`skip-changeset`: move-only. The published `.d.ts` files and export lists are byte-identical, `liveness/` and every other published path are untouched, and the module's runtime is the same code under a different file name.
